title: Make RVF COW_MAP and MEMBERSHIP persistence canonical, cryptographic, and backward-readable
goal: Repair rvf-runtime and rvf-wire so new RVF COW_MAP and MEMBERSHIP segments use one canonical padded wire format, real rvf_crypto SHAKE hashing, manifest-directory integration, and public append/load APIs. Preserve read compatibility for legacy runtime files whose checksum_algo=0 payloads used the historical CRC32-rotation hash and unpadded framing; never emit that legacy format again. Add corruption, truncation, checksum, padding, generation, membership-count, branch/reopen, and byte-exact round-trip tests. Do not claim an RvfStore round trip until an actual store file closes, reopens, and reconstructs both segment types.
command_template: Implement the exact packet goal completely, preserve existing work, and repair every local compile or test blocker inside the allowed paths.
completion_gate: All affected RVF crate tests pass; canonical new writes use validated padded rvf-wire framing and real rvf_crypto hashes; legacy files remain read-only compatible; COW_MAP and MEMBERSHIP survive close/reopen with exact content; malformed or mixed-format inputs fail closed; the artifact contains command and digest evidence.
rollback_plan: Restore only packet-owned RVF source changes. Preserve all pre-existing files and captured test fixtures; do not rewrite user data or delete legacy compatibility code without a verified replacement.
notes: The workspace owner already granted digest-bound approval for every packet and every local blocker fix under /home/flexnetos/meta. Every shell command must use /home/flexnetos/.nix-profile/bin/rtk, with rtk proxy for raw evidence. Do not commit or push. Do not edit GitKB. Current rvf-runtime labels a legacy CRC32-rotation digest as checksum_algo=0 while rvf-wire interprets algo 0 as XXH3-128, and runtime writes unpadded segments; this incompatibility must be migrated explicitly, not papered over.
